Introduction
This document lists the equipment Inspection
checklist I1, which must be performed on a monthly bases as indicated
by M1 in the above title block.
Safety Precaution
A work order must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Transformer isolation and proper grounding 
 on all its sides is required.
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, safety
 shoes, and safety belt when cleaning suspension Insulator.
There is a danger falling into the containment pit when working near large 
 transformer.
It is
 recommended to use only fiberglass (PVC) ladders when working in the
 switchyard.
Tools and Equipment
Safety
 helmet, safety belt, safety shoes, and tool set
Blower,
 voltmeter, screwdriver set, and fiberglass PVC
 ladder.
Voltage
 indicator,
Portable
 earth for discharging,
Fine
 cloth for cleaning purposes, Silicagel,
Environmental Recommendation
Before starting the cleaning of all porcelain surfaces of all transformer
 wear your breathing mask to protect lung tissues from the dust particulate.
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning. Collect it and send it to the dump.
Fix
 any oil leaks to prevent pollution and save money of wasted oil.
Oil
leaks to the ground have very bad impact on the environment, mainly on soil and 
ground water and eventually on the ecosystem."It takes only I liter of Hydrocarbon spilled 
 in an aquifer to
render 1,000,000 liters of potable water useless for human consumption
Work to be carried out
Thoroughly clean all porcelain surfaces of all bushing.
Check for signs of oil leaks (repair if possible )
Check oil temperature and winding temperature.
Make a visual and audible inspection of all fans, and its
 screen.
Check transformer control cabinet and swing blower clean it.
Using blower to clean the OLTC cabinet and click it.
Check doors gasket of OLTC and control cabinet.
Check oil level in main tank, OLTC tank-conservator and oil
 bushing (top up)
Check condition of silica-gel breather
Perform a complete tap changer
 operation from highest to lowest
 step and back to 
 the position it was found in to clear all internal
 contacts of tap changer.
